changes.evidence: Spider-Man: Brand New Day: Jean possesses MJ after tracing her through Ned's online post of their new apartment, kisses Peter as MJ on the rooftop, then leaps from the building and lets go so Spider-Man catches MJ. Peter later tells MJ the truth and that he loves her at Castle's base (Fandom film summary). None of this happens on Roosevelt Island. MJ's only Roosevelt Island link is being frozen and crying, from wherever she is, inside Jean's psionic field during the Escape from the Damage Control Roosevelt Island Facility, which this record doesn't describe. The right place is MJ and Ned's apartment building, which isn't among the app's places, so the proposal is [].
